business_problem: Revolut needed to replace siloed fraud, credit, marketing, and recommendation models that depended on months of feature engineering with a single behavioral foundation model that could learn from raw financial event streams and scale efficiently across fast-growing markets.
solution_summary: Revolut rebuilt its AI stack around PRAGMA, a transformer-based family of behavioral foundation models trained on NVIDIA accelerated computing. The architecture uses three encoders for user attributes, individual events, and long-term history, then applies structured tokenization to convert profile fields, transaction streams, amounts, and timestamps into a shared temporal representation. NVIDIA Llama-Nemotron-Embed-1B-v2 enriches the backbone with embeddings from unstructured merchant descriptions. Revolut pre-trained PRAGMA on NVIDIA H100 GPU clusters in Nebius AI Cloud, using shard-based dynamic batching, sequence packing, and variable-length attention to raise throughput and fit training into fixed windows. Downstream teams either freeze the backbone and add lightweight heads or apply LoRA fine-tuning, so fraud, credit, recommendations, and growth models all reuse the same behavioral intelligence layer.

solution_components.name: PRAGMA
solution_components.role: Acts as Revolut’s shared behavioral foundation model backbone for fraud, credit, recommendation, and growth use cases.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA H100 GPUs
solution_components.role: Provide the accelerated compute used to pre-train and refresh PRAGMA at foundation-model scale.

solution_components.name: Nebius AI Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts the H100-based training clusters used for large-scale pre-training.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Llama-Nemotron-Embed-1B-v2
solution_components.role: Embeds unstructured merchant descriptions to improve the model’s behavioral signal.

data_flow: Raw customer attributes, transactions, timestamps, and merchant text are tokenized into PRAGMA, H100 clusters pre-train shared embeddings on Nebius AI Cloud, and downstream fraud, credit, recommendation, and growth tasks consume the shared backbone through linear heads or LoRA adapters.
business_outcome: Revolut reports 3–5x faster model-development cycles, 2–5x higher training throughput, 2.3x better credit default risk accuracy, 65 percent more fraud cases caught with 17 percent higher fraud precision, and 41 percent more relevant product recommendations by consolidating on PRAGMA.

With NVIDIA H100 GPUs on Nebius AI Cloud via sequence packing and dynamic batching, making large-scale pre-training feasible within fixed windows.

Major gains over production baselines, including 2.3× better accuracy at identifying credit default risk, 65% more fraud cases caught while also being 17% more precise in fraud alerts, and 41% more relevant product recommendations.

Teams can either freeze the model and train lightweight linear heads on top of embeddings for rapid experiments or apply LoRA fine-tuning, updating only 2%–4% of parameters.
